# Preview icon sources

These 24 unmodified PNGs are preview fixtures from
[mingrammer/diagrams](https://github.com/mingrammer/diagrams/tree/5a9e8af2d4e48ae2bbd002a4c0ca714d5b9219e1/resources)
at revision `5a9e8af2d4e48ae2bbd002a4c0ca714d5b9219e1`.
The directory structure below this file preserves their upstream paths under
`resources/`. The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE.txt`.

AWS, Azure and Google Cloud service artwork and trademarks belong to their
respective owners. Inclusion demonstrates the search design; it does not imply
endorsement. These files are served locally by the preview fixture server and
are not included in the production tool catalog or UI bundle.
